digest.component_or_area: tickets store fsck repair and maintenance
propositions: Pre-existing fsck baseline contains 550 SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL, 10 ORPHAN_EVENT (all LINK/AUTO-RECOVER type), and 1 STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit record across 9-10 tickets
Safety tooling landed in Gerrit 1391 adds scoped stale-channel repair via --only flag with mixed-fault refusal and resumable batching by --limit
AUTO-RECOVER orphan repair must run before stale-channel batches in quiet-window to avoid dangling post-repair audit records
Live execution completed orphan repair in one commit plus three stale-channel batches, reaching exactly 4 STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit records with zero repairable diagnostics remaining
Rollback capability verified via disposable bundle restore proving exact pre-repair tip and full 561-diagnostic manifest recovery
Post-repair independent fsck verification confirms zero SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL, zero ORPHAN_EVENT, and zero corruption findings
